Case N06: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 201x201x71 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text: Finished PNST segmentation: posterolateral deep + exophytic subcutaneous nodules (1.9 mL, 2 components, axial 21-48). Anterior hyperintensity proven to be vessels (prompt leaked to vascular tree) and excluded. Final review confirmed boundaries and no tumor beyond mask.
